items.title: Is This BSX Stock Pullback Worth The Patience?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) trades at about $43, roughly 17% below the recent high it set on 19th Aug, 2026. Its own history with sharp drops is encouraging. That history does not cover a cyberattack it says is likely to hit its 2026 results, and the stock is down about 60% over the past twelve months. Start with the history.

items.title: CMS expands TAVR Medicare coverage to asymptomatic patients
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services’ policy update extends Medicare coverage to severe aortic stenosis patients without symptoms, a change that analysts said will especially benefit Edwards Lifesciences.

items.title: How Much Can ISRG Stock Still Move Against You?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) has handed its owners a hard year. The stock is down 25% over the trailing twelve months while the S&P 500 returned 19.3%, and it now trades about 41% below its 52-week high. After a fall like that the natural hope is that the big moves are behind you. Options priced a year out say they are not.
